response.description:
Azure Functions support for Node.js 24 is now
generally available.   You can now develop apps using Node.js 24 locally
and deploy them to supported Azure Functions plans on Linux and
Windows, including the Flex Consumption plan.     Please note that Remote Build on Flex Consumption for
Node.js 24 is rolling out and will be available in all public regions in the
coming week.  Learn more:  Updating
your app to Node.js 24  Azure
Functions Node.js versions end of support dates
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Functions Support for Node.js 24
